notes_for_editor: The 1928 and 1930 newspaper items (transcribed on the Forest Lookouts site) are the only sources that describe this tower. No build date, removal date or staffing record for this tower was found. The May 23 item calls it 'a fourth tower of wooden construction'; the May 31 item calls it 'an older wooden tower' among four park towers; not a real conflict, but the story only says one of four. The 2016 trip report mentions no tower. A search summary claimed 1928 steel towers on Fingerboard, Bear Mountain and Jackie Jones; not verified from pages read and not used. Jackie Jones status comes from a 2021 trail note and may be out of date.
